extraction.text:
Arun R Patil

Seeking an opportunity in Data Science, Generative AI, and Agentic AI, with a strong interest in continuous learning and applying AI to drive innovation, problem-solving, and data-driven creativity.

Bangalore - 9739953471 arunpatil881990@gmail.com

www.linkedin.com/in/arun- patil-24610366/

EXPERIENCE

Tavant Technologies, Bangalore – Data Scientist March 2021 – Present

Claims Review Copilot – Designed and deployed a multi-agent AI system using Python, LangGraph, LangChain, and RAG, deployed on Azure Web Apps, to assist in claims analysis. The system predicts the most suitable QA codes (Defect, Remedy, Symptom), identifies correlations among comments, assesses issue severity, recommends new QA codes, summarizes incidents, and generates suspect scores to classify claims as suspicious or non-suspicious. The integrated output supports claim processors in making final acceptance or denial decisions.

Data Science Agentic AI – Machine Learning Lifecycle

Designed and implemented an AI-agent–driven machine learning lifecycle using Python, Autogen Framework, and LLM GPT-4o, integrating exploratory data analysis, preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation agents. Each stage was powered by modular sub-agents to automate data handling, reporting, and execution. The system included a preprocessing agent for streamlined data preparation, a feature engineering agent for optimized feature generation, and a model performance comparison. This end-to-end agentic solution architecture provides a approach for building robust machine learning workflows.

Triage Based AI Intelligent Search - Developed an Agentic AI solution integrating LangGraph, Langchain, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI (GPT models), RAG, GEN AI, Python to enhance field service support through intelligent search and retrieval. Structured data from Azure SQL and unstructured data such as manuals from Blob Storage were indexed using embeddings for semantic search. The system interprets technician queries, reformulates them when necessary, and retrieves the most relevant service reports. It identifies recent service tickets and recommends troubleshooting steps, replacement parts, and appropriate manuals by matching embeddings from prior reports and documents.

Fraud Detection in Claim Filing – Built and deployed a Machine Learning model in Azure (via MLOps CI/CD pipeline), Azure ML Studio to detect fraudulent claims by generating a suspect score that classifies claims as suspicious or non-suspicious.

TMAP Early Warning System – Developed and deployed a predictive maintenance system in Azure (via MLOps CI/CD pipeline), Azure ML Studio leveraging clustering, multi-class classification, time series forecasting, and binary classification models to detect early machine failures.

APL Analyst IT Solutions Private Limited, Bangalore – Data Scientist, November 2018 – March 2021 - (CenturyLink) Building AI Voice/Chat Bot Using Google Dialogflow and Clinc Platform- Developed a conversational AI virtual assistant for traders capable of responding with accurate stock values for both live and historical data, while also assisting in order placement. The bot not only understands

SKILLS

Programming Languages:

R, JAVA, Python

Artificial Intelligence:

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LangChain, LangGraph Framework, AutoGen Framework, LLMs (Large Language Models), Azure OpenAI, GPT Models, LangFuse, Vector Databases (FAISS), Agentic AI Systems, Prompt Engineering, Embedding Models and MLOps for LLMs its LLMops

DATA SCIENCE:

Machine Learning and Deep Learning: Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision tree, Random Forest tree, K- Nearest Neighbor, Support vector machine, Naïve Bayes, Neural Networks, CNN, RNN

Principal component analysis

Cluster Analysis:

K-Means, hierarchical clustering

Recommender systems: Collaborative filtering Market Basket Analysis

Natural Language Processing: Sentiment Analysis, POS Tagging Tokenization, Classification Named Entity Recognition

Cloud Technologies:

Microsoft Azure - Virtual Machine, Database, Data Factory, Blob Storage, Azure Vector Search, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Azure Web Apps, Azure ML Studio

Azure DevOps/MLOps - CI/CD Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Model Deployment & Monitoring.

AWS-Redshift, EC2, S3, RDS

natural language but also provides context-based replies and insights on stock trends. Implemented using Python, Pandas, NLTK, Beautiful Soup, Google Dialogflow, Clinc Platform, Flask, and Webhooks, with integration to Azure Cloud Database and Data Factory for data management.

Text Classification for Predicting Call Conversations - Developed a multiclass predictive modeling solution on call conversation text data to automatically predict tags and assign them to the appropriate group, enabling faster resolution of customer queries. Implemented using machine learning algorithms, ensemble modeling techniques, and deep learning architecture (Neural Networks, LSTM) with Python and NLP (NLTK) for text processing.

Concentrix Daksh Services India Private Limited, Bangalore – Asstt, Manager Analytics, March 2018 – May 2018

Building Text Mining Model for Context Detection - Developed a text mining model using R to detect context and extract phrases related to specific topics in text data. Implemented NLP techniques such as tokenization, stop-word removal, synonym detection, and POS tagging, combined with machine learning methods to improve context accuracy. Integrated with SQL for data handling and preprocessing.

LAVA International Ltd (R&D Center), Bangalore — Test engineer, Jan 2015 – Feb 2018

Worked in the Data Testing and Data Science team, developing SQL queries in AWS Redshift, performing data analysis, and preparing business reports.

User Engagement Prediction Models- Developed predictive models in R to enhance user engagement and reduce churn by forecasting notification clicks and app launches. Implemented data cleaning, regression, and classification techniques using logistic regression, linear regression, SVM, random forest, neural networks, KNN, and ensemble methods (Gradient Boosting, XGBoost) to improve accuracy and optimize RMSE values.

EDUCATION

TimesPro, Bangalore — PGD in Data Science

July 2017 – December 2017

RVCE, Bangalore — MCA (74.20%)

July 2011 - July 2014

RLSC, Belgaum — BCA (77.02%)

July 2008 - July 2011

Operating System:

Microsoft Windows, Linux

Database:

RDBMS, SQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, oracle SQL

Tools:

RStudio, Anaconda, Jira, Visual Studio, Postman

CERTIFICATIONS AND TRAININGS

AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty

AI-102: Designing and implementing a Microsoft Azure AI Solution
